scope: Synthetic 144-DPI WinForms client layout on a native 96-DPI monitor only
limitation: Windows continues to own a 96-DPI native resize frame. Fixture-only frame compensation is applied separately before editing, after expansion/collapse, and after restoration when needed; raw bounds and constraints are recorded. This does not verify native 150-percent window frames, track-size enforcement, or monitor switching.
